title: Best bands of the 1930s
summary: He names Fletcher Henderson, John Kirby's group and McKinney's Cotton Pickers.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: In bands which would you say - when they say the King of Swing, they're also saying that his band was the best band and the swingingest band of the 30's. Is that so?
According to you, who had the best or the swingingest band during the 30's?
I'll tell you one - Fletcher Henderson. Let's see, who was the other one?
The band that you were in with Fletcher Henderson?
I don't know if I was in the band then or not, but I know he had the band.
Would they compare almost on the same level -
Yes, with any other big swing band. They were from out of Detroit.
